caption: The drawing features two views of a round, intricately patterned trivet, depicted in grayscale. The object has a circular form with a raised edge and an ornate, openwork design consisting of intersecting curved and straight bands that create a grid-like pattern. Within this grid, there are six smaller circles equally spaced around a central, larger circle. Each of the six smaller circles contains a symmetric, star-shaped motif, while the central circle holds a similar but larger star-like pattern. The trivet stands on three short legs, making it slightly elevated above the surface. The upper section of the drawing shows a plan view with a side profile, and the lower section presents a more perspective view, showcasing the depth and three-dimensional structure of the trivet. The background is plain, and the overall color scheme of the drawing is a monochromatic beige and gray, with shading used to detail the object's form and texture. A scale and a signature labeled “Filippo Berona” appear near the bottom left of the image.
title: Pa. German Trivet
